questions.question: Where should the rule-based bucket selector (Q1–Q15) be kept as an alternative to the P0 statistics approach in PR 1074?

options.label: Research note (Recommended)
options.description: New sdd/research/ note on its own branch, linked from the BK-403 dossier. PR 1074 keeps its stop verdict and links to the note as the alternative. Nothing in RFC-0019 changes until the alternative is validated. Cheapest, and keeps the two approaches separate.

options.label: Fold into PR 1074
options.description: Add the note to PR 1074, so the stop verdict and the alternative land together. One review, one merge, but it mixes a finished measurement with an untested proposal, and PR 1074 gets bigger.

options.label: RFC-0019 amendment
options.description: Rewrite RFC-0019's selector (D5/D6) and Phase 0 around the buckets. Most authoritative, but it commits the RFC to an approach nothing has measured yet.

options.label: New RFC
options.description: A separate RFC that competes with RFC-0019's D5. Clean separation, but there would be two live RFCs on one topic until one is withdrawn.
